name: needs_you
title: Needs you: add or close an item for Edwin
description: Only for a step only Edwin (or a server-level helper) can do. action=add: type publish (a Base44 Publish: target app, ref = 24-char checkpoint id, summary = what it changes) or server (.htaccess, PHP, cPanel, DNS, domain verification: target site, ref = file or setting, summary + why). A new item sends ONE notice to Grok Bot; the same open step again sends nothing. Never for routine progress. action=done: only after you confirmed on live that the step happened (live_check) and re-checked the site (site_recheck); sends no notice. action=resend: only when the notice never arrived. Short plain text only: no file contents, no keys.

target.description: add: site or app, e.g. Bluehost Bridge, Page One Controller, SgGarage Controller, commercialfitout.sg

ref.description: add: checkpoint id (publish) or file / setting (server)

summary.description: add: one line, what is needed (max 200)

live_check.description: done: what you confirmed on live

confirm_resend.description: resend: true only after Grok Bot confirmed it never got a notice that timed out

name: list_needs_you
title: Needs you: list open items (read only)
description: Read-only. Open needs-you items for Edwin (status open, done or all), or one item by id, to confirm an item is real and still open. Shows no secrets and no file contents.
